svg.font-family: Inter, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
svg.title: Sanad patient flow
svg.desc: Flow from private entry and consent, through deterministic safety checks (S0, S0b, input guardrail, S1), adaptive intake, the Gatekeeper, draft rules and report, review and release, to optional closed-loop navigation. Emergency guidance wins at every safety check. Based on BRD v0.4.2 section 7 and PRD v0.4.2 sections 1.3, 4.7 and 4.7.1.
svg.text: Safety-first assessment and optional closed-loop navigation · BRD v0.4.2 §7 and PRD v0.4.2 §1.3, §4.7, §4.7.1 (integrated review draft)
SAFETY FIRST · DETERMINISTIC CODE, NO MODEL
ASSESSMENT · AI MAY DRAFT, CODE VALIDATES
up to 3 optional context items, never triage
S1 · safety re-check on new facts
a model can never lower the rule floor
no diagnosis, probability or unsourced claim
REVIEW AND RELEASE · BACKEND POLICY DECIDES
a correction is a new event
Every outcome writes a thin, source-labelled audit event: who, when, which action and which versions. Never answers, lab values or free text.
No path writes PROVIDER_VERIFIED or CARE_COMPLETED. Clinical rules, triggers, thresholds and wording are unapproved drafts (CLINICAL_TBD).
Research prototype · synthetic data only · not a medical device.
